speaker: Tony
line: Chad, you’re holding that rose like it’s a damn parking ticket you’re about to fight—relax, it ain’t gonna save you if you blow this turn, you know what I mean?

speaker: Tony
line: Listen, Guest, I’m scared of clowns, alright? Not the funny birthday kind—no, no—the creepy ones that sit shotgun in your car while you parallel park. Cousin Sal hired one once, swore it was a joke. I nearly stalled Lorraine three times. True story. But between you and me? I’m scared of ending up stuck here with Chad hogging all the ice and the damn rose like it’s the last slice of pizza. You got calm hands, by the way. Real calm. That’s weird coming from me, huh? Anyway, you better not be the type to ghost when it’s time to signal outta here. You know what I mean?

speaker: Tony
line: Listen, tonight’s like that moment right before you hit a tight parallel park spot—everyone’s pretending they got it, but half of them are about to crunch the bumper. Chad’s clutching that rose like it’s a damn trophy for best selfish move, and Willa’s just steppin’ on everyone’s nerves like it’s her own personal course. Meanwhile, Vati’s over there swirling his drink like the king of the world, and me? I’m just here hoping someone lets me teach ’em how to back up without making a mess. Nobody’s honest, everyone’s playing nice, but you? You just walked in with one suitcase—either you’re a secret weapon or a suitcase acting like a bomb. Ain’t happenin’ without someone signaling first, you know what I mean?
